subject: english
stem: A text says thicker cloth slows cooling. Data after 10 minutes: thin cloth 42°C; medium 48°C; thick 53°C. Which point is supported?
options: Thicker cloth is associated with higher remaining temperature.
Thin cloth kept the most heat.
All cloth gave the same result.
Cloth thickness had no relation to temperature.

optionRationales.reason: Thicker cloth is associated with higher remaining temperature.：厚度增加時十分鐘後溫度依序較高。
Thin cloth kept the most heat.：42 最低。
All cloth gave the same result.：三值不同。
Cloth thickness had no relation to temperature.：數據呈一致方向。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「文字提出的關係需由數據方向、差值與單位共同驗證」可推出 Thicker cloth is associated with higher remaining temperature.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Thicker cloth is associated with higher remaining temperature. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
